description: One-launch real-shape BF16 GDN-2 decode with raw gate activation, FP32 recurrence, RMSNorm, swish and BF16 output.

decay_rate.note: Precomputed -exp(A_log), one strictly-negative scalar broadcast across each head row.

norm_weight.note: The requested BF16 checkpoint value widened once to FP32 during immutable inference packing.

initial_state.note: K-major, read-only and never aliased with final_state.

o.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

final_state.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Token-major contiguous BTHD activations/output; K-major BHKV state.
domain.configuration: allow_neg_eigval=false, qk_norm_eps=1e-6, norm_eps=1e-5, attention_scale=128^-0.5 and swish output gate.
domain.precision: BF16 activations widen on entry. Gate activation, q/k reductions, recurrence, RMSNorm, swish and state use FP32. Output narrows once with ties-to-even; state stays FP32.
domain.ownership: block_dim=8 yields 16 vector participants and each owns one complete head; there is no cross-core reduction or synchronization.
domain.aliasing: All inputs are read-only; o and final_state are fresh complete-overwrite outputs with disjoint storage.

default.reason: All internal arithmetic is FP32, but native exp/log/reduction order and the final BF16 RNE may differ from the independent Torch tree; bitwise identity is not required.

o.reason: The BF16 output may move by one storage ULP after the CCE transcendental/reduction tree; the strong-decay simulator case measured max_abs=0.0078125 on 2/2048 values and relative-L2=4.620e-5.

final_state.reason: State remains FP32; only native transcendental and register reduction order may differ from the CPU formula.

measured.static: Pinned Ascriptor 0.1.0: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 404 surface operations; CCE emitted 415 lowered operations.
measured.simulation: All 3 cases passed functional sim and pipesim without hazard/deadlock. Strong-decay BF16 o differed at 2/2048 elements by one ULP: max_abs=0.0078125, relative-L2=4.620e-5; FP32 state relative-L2 was at most 4.108e-7. The accepted static two-slot schedule measured 9613 model cycles versus 10463 for the dynamically indexed DBuff negative control and 9444 for the serial whole-state source; modeled multi-pipe overlap rose from 3.68% to 11.44%.
measured.board_cce: Canonical unit runner executed real_decode through requested_backend=cce and launcher=aclnn. BF16 o max_abs=7.451e-9 / relative-L2=8.574e-11; FP32 state max_abs=3.278e-7 / relative-L2=3.044e-7.
measured.whole_model: Real 95B BF16 packed model passed both load orders. Prompt/step logits relative-L2=3.260e-3/3.436e-3; worst step recurrent-cache relative-L2=9.521e-3 under the existing 1e-2 budget. The fused path generated the same readable 32-token continuation.
measured.profile: Standalone Casts remain 74 per token after fusion. Two independent static-two-slot profiles (54 kernel calls each) measured a combined mean/median 4.247/4.256 us per layer, versus an immediate whole-state control at 4.733/4.716 us: 1.114x/1.108x faster. Combined mean AIV Vector/Scalar/MTE2/MTE3 ratios were 34.73/17.60/37.52/21.70%; the four-pipe sum was 111.55%, versus 86.84% in the matched control, establishing real overlap. Every profiler kernel row reported physical device 7.
measured.paired_latency: warmup=100/repeat=200: torch-first 8.087 vs 4.900 ms (1.650x); CCE-first 8.726 vs 6.188 ms (1.410x). Both numerical comparisons passed.
measured.scheduling_negative_control: Hazard-free dynamically indexed 16/32/64-row DBuff variants increased pipesim cycles from 9444 to 14801/11917/10463. The dynamic 64-row silicon candidate regressed 4.654->4.804 us and its four AIV pipes summed to 98.17%, exposing near serialization. Statically naming and unrolling the two 64-row slots removed the false read1->compute0 and write0->compute1 dependencies: pipesim fell to 9613 cycles, modeled overlap rose to 11.44%, and two silicon acquisitions measured 4.259/4.236 us means around a matched 4.733 us whole-state control.
measured.exit_criteria: Correctness, the 74-Cast floor, pairwise MTE2/Vector and Vector/MTE3 overlap, and deployed kernel latency passed. A single main pipe still does not average about 80% because the all-row erase->delta join separates the two legal pipelines; meeting that separate saturation target requires a wider useful fusion boundary rather than artificial work or fewer cores.
measured.device_isolation: Both profiler acquisitions and the full-model validation reported only physical device 7 and had zero physical-device-0 active samples. A later canonical aclnn fresh build showed one transient physical-device-0 python entry at 0 MB before the actual test_aclnnop appeared only on device 7; its timing aligns with the CANN opc build, but the exited PID cannot be namespace-mapped after the fact. No device-0 residency remained, and further fresh builds are prohibited during the strict device-7-only window.

provenance.source: GatedLinearAttention2 fused_recurrent_gdn2 and FusedRMSNormGated semantics at revision 7fb9cb84260779a8715f3dba855abc4cab6924d4
provenance.disposition: Formula and public tensor semantics were independently reimplemented; no Triton source was copied.
Retains the measured one-complete-head-per-vector ownership and resident FP32 state, while widening the model-specific fusion boundary.

release_scope.note: Repository-owned model-specific inference unit; not part of Ascriptor 0.1.0.
